content: Ermaasanne Kawo Sedeqiyaasa
Baabiloone kawo Nabukadanaxoorey Iyo7aaqeme naa Iyo7aakine sohon Iyosiyaasa naa Sedeqiyaasa Yuhuda biittan kawoththides.
Gido attiin Sedeqiyaasi, iza shuumetinne dere asay ubbay GODAY nabe Ermaasa baggara yootida qaalas azazettibeettenna.
Kawo Sedeqiyaasi, Shelemiya naa Yekaalenne Ma7isaya naa qeese Sofonaasa nabe Ermaasakko, «GODAA nu Xoossaa nuus woossa» giidi kiittides.
He wode Ermaasi buro qasho keeth gelontta diza gishshas ba shene mala simerettishe dees.
Gibxe kawo olanchchati Gibxeppe kezidi yizayssa Yerusalaame giddoththida Baabiloone olanchchati siyida wode istti Yerusalaameppe aggidi guye simmida.
Hessafe guye GODAA qaalay nabe Ermaasakko yiidi,
GODAA Isra7eele Xoossay, «Tana intte oychchana mala inttena kiittida Yuhuda kawos, ‹Be7ite, inttena maaddanaas kezida Gibxe kawo olanchchati bantta biitta guye simmi baana.
Baabiloone olanchchatikka simmi yiidi hanno ha katamayo oli oykkananne izo xuuggana› giite» gees.
GODAY, « ‹Baabiloone olanchchati nuna tumappe aggi bida› giidi qoppofte; istti aggi bontta gishshas inttena intterkka baleththofte.
Inttenara olettiza Baabiloone olanchchata intte xooniin istta dunkaane giddon madunxida asi xalla attikokka heyti yiidi hanno ha katamayo xuuggana» gees.
Ermaasa Qasheteth
Baabiloone olanchchati Gibxe kawo olanchchata gaason Yerusalaame yeggi kezidaappe guye,
He wode Ermaasi deraa giddon bana gakkiza xinxxo ekkanaas Biniyaame biitta baanaas Yerusalaameppe dendides.
Gido attiin izi biidi Biniyaame Penge gakkishin zabeta halaqa Hanaaniya naaza Shelemiya naa Yiiriyay iza, «Neni deraa kaddada Baabiloone asaakko baana gaasa!» giidi oykkides.
Ermaasikka, «Neni gizayssi wordo; tani kaddada Baabiloone biza as gidikke» gides; gido attiin Yiiriyay izi gizayssa siyontta ixxidi Ermaasa oykki ekkidi shuumetakko efides.
Shuumetikka keehi hanqettidi Ermaasa wadhdhida; hessafe guye istti qasho keeth histtida xaafe Yoonataane keeththan efi qachchida.
Ermaasi heen biitta garsan diza qasho keeththan daro wode gam7ides.

Hessafe guye kawo Sedeqiyaasi as kiittidi Ermaasa ba dizaso kawo keeth xeygi ehisides; iza xalla efidi, «GODAAPPE yida qaalay neekkon dizee?» gi oychchides. Ermaasi zaaridi, «Ee dees; neni Baabiloone kawo kushen aadhdha imettana» gides.
Qasseka Ermaasi Kawo Sedeqiyaasas, «Intte tana qasho keeththan yegganaas tani intte bolla, inttes ooththiza shuumeta bolla woykko ha asaa bolla ay mooro ooththadinaa?
‹Ane Baabiloone kawoy inttenanne ha biittayo yiidi olenna› giidi inttes tinbite yootida nabeti ha7i awan dizoo?
Hessa gishshas ta godawu kawoo! Ta gizaaz ezga! Ta nena woossays. Tani heen hayqqontta mala xaafe Yoonataane soo zaara yeddofa» gides.

Kawo Sedeqiyaasi zabe naagizayta zagon daana malanne he katamayn diza kaththi wuranaashe gakkanaas kath kaththizayta heerappe gallas gallas issi issi buddennay izas imettana mala azazides; hessa gishshas Ermaasi zabe naagizayta zagon de7ides.
